An '''armor section''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
An armor section was never deployed in the field as a single element. Armor sections contained either two three-man [[Medium repulsortank|medium]] or [[light repulsortank]]s, for a total of six men per section, or one four- or five-man [[heavy repulsortank]].<ref name="ISB" />
